improvement_detail: exact and generic; useless when transients or periods are long (affine quasigroups, many geometric-width rules); memory grows with mu + lambda
statement: Storing visited rows answers a query t in mu + lambda simulated steps; for random rows of length 32 this is at most 5000 steps for 1590 of 1734 order-3 classes (median transient 5, median period 2), but it fails for the affine quasigroups and for 128 of 300 geometric-width classes.
title: Cycle detection as a generic fast-forward
